TxHA PEEK IBF/TxTiHA IBF System REF BTA-151

i. TxHA   The Innovasis TxHA PEEK IBF System is an intervertebral body fusion device intended to stabilize a spinal segment to promote fusion using bone graft, in order to restrict motion and decrease pain.
